item.content:encoded:
What's the site's view on converting old cryptozoologist theories into SCPs?

See SCP-1000 and SCP-2511 for case studies.

It is okay to use crytozoological creatures for SCPs, but you have to do something with it. If it's just the creature wholesale transplanted as an SCP, that is not enough. Do something with that basic idea. Make it your own thing. Put a spin to it that makes your unique.
